--- title: "Tweedie Offset–Weight Equivalence" --- This chapter provides: - A data generator for Tweedie totals with exposure - scikit-learn TweedieRegressor: rates + correct `sample_weight = exposure**(2 - p)` - LightGBM Tweedie: (A) totals + offset via `init_score=log(exposure)`, (B) rates + `sample_weight = exposure**(2 - p)` - Numeric checks: deviance equivalence across implementations - Special cases: Poisson (p=1), Gamma (p=2) **Attention:** valid for generic Tweedie. For a Compound Poisson-Gamma, the distribution is also Tweedie but with a specific dispersion. For application to pure-premium modelling, refer to the theory chapter and the pure-premium tutorial. ::: {#8603379d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from __future__ import annotations import math import typing import warnings import numpy as np import pandas as pd from numpy.random import default_rng from sklearn.linear_model import TweedieRegressor from sklearn.metrics import mean_tweedie_deviance, root_mean_squared_error from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split import lightgbm as lgb from rich import box from rich.console import Console from rich.table import Table console = Console() np.set_printoptions(suppress=True, linewidth=120) EXPOSURE_FLOOR = 1e-9 LGB_DISABLE_BOOST_FROM_AVERAGE = True def emit(message: str) -> None: """Print a message with Rich when available.""" console.print(message) def _format_value(value: object) -> str: """Format values for terminal tables.""" if isinstance(value, (np.integer, int)): return f"{int(value):,}" if isinstance(value, (np.floating, float)): value = float(value) if abs(value) >= 1: return f"{value:,.4f}" return f"{value:.6e}" return str(value) def print_table(title: str, rows: typing.Iterable[tuple[str, object]]) -> None: """Print a simple two-column summary table.""" table = Table(title=title, box=box.SIMPLE_HEAVY, header_style="bold magenta") table.add_column("Metric", style="bold") table.add_column("Value", justify="right", style="cyan") for key, value in rows: table.add_row(str(key), _format_value(value)) console.print(table) ``` ::: ## Tweedie utilities ::: {#dfd34fc3 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} def tweedie_compound_poisson_gamma_params( mu: np.ndarray, phi: float, p: float ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, np.ndarray]: """Map Tweedie parameters to compound Poisson-Gamma (λ, a, θ).""" if not (1.0 < p < 2.0): raise ValueError("Compound Poisson–Gamma mapping only valid for 1 < p < 2.") lam = (mu ** (2.0 - p)) / (phi * (2.0 - p)) a = (2.0 - p) / (p - 1.0) theta = phi * (p - 1.0) * (mu ** (p - 1.0)) return lam, a, theta def rng_tweedie_totals( mu: np.ndarray, phi: float, p: float, rng: np.random.Generator ) -> np.ndarray: """Simulate totals from a Tweedie distribution via compound Poisson-Gamma.""" mu = np.asarray(mu, dtype=float) n = mu.shape[0] out = np.zeros(n, dtype=float) if abs(p - 1.0) < 1e-12: out = rng.poisson(lam=np.maximum(mu, 0)) return out.astype(float) if abs(p - 2.0) < 1e-12: k = 1.0 / max(phi, 1e-9) theta = mu / np.maximum(k, 1e-9) out = rng.gamma(shape=k, scale=theta) return out if not (1.0 < p < 2.0): raise ValueError("Supports only p in {1} ∪ (1,2) ∪ {2}.") lam, a, theta = tweedie_compound_poisson_gamma_params(mu, phi, p) N = rng.poisson(lam=lam) for i in range(n): if N[i] <= 0: out[i] = 0.0 else: out[i] = rng.gamma(shape=a * N[i], scale=theta[i]) return out ``` ::: ## Data generation ::: {#1f6f99b2 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} def make_insurance_data( n: int = 50_000, p_index: float = 1.9, phi: float = 0.8, n_features: int = 6, seed: int = 7, ) -> pd.DataFrame: """Generate synthetic insurance-style data with Tweedie totals.""" rng = default_rng(seed) X = rng.normal(size=(n, n_features)) beta = rng.normal(scale=0.4, size=n_features) linpred = X @ beta mu_rate = np.exp(linpred) exposure = np.exp(rng.normal(loc=-0.1, scale=0.6, size=n)) mu_total = exposure * mu_rate Y = rng_tweedie_totals(mu_total, phi=phi, p=p_index, rng=rng) df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=[f"x{j}" for j in range(n_features)]) df["Exposure"] = exposure df["Total"] = Y df["Rate"] = np.divide(Y, exposure, out=np.zeros_like(Y), where=exposure > 0) return df ``` ::: ## Fitting helpers ::: {#9da48578 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} def fit_sklearn_tweedie_rates( df_train: pd.DataFrame, df_test: pd.DataFrame, feature_cols: list[str], p: float, alpha: float = 0.1, ) -> tuple: """scikit-learn TweedieRegressor on rates with weight = exposure^(2-p).""" Xtr = df_train[feature_cols].to_numpy() Xte = df_test[feature_cols].to_numpy() rtr = df_train["Rate"].to_numpy() rte = df_test["Rate"].to_numpy() wtr = (df_train["Exposure"].to_numpy()) ** (2.0 - p) wte = (df_test["Exposure"].to_numpy()) ** (2.0 - p) glm = TweedieRegressor(power=p, alpha=alpha, solver="newton-cholesky") glm.fit(Xtr, rtr, sample_weight=wtr) rhat_tr = glm.predict(Xtr) rhat_te = glm.predict(Xte) yhat_tr = rhat_tr * df_train["Exposure"].to_numpy() yhat_te = rhat_te * df_test["Exposure"].to_numpy() return glm, (yhat_tr, yhat_te), (rhat_tr, rhat_te), (Xtr, Xte, rtr, rte, wtr, wte) def fit_lgbm_tweedie_totals_offset( df_train: pd.DataFrame, df_test: pd.DataFrame, feature_cols: list[str], p: float, num_boost_round: int = 300, seed: int = 13, ) -> tuple[lgb.Booster, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]: """LightGBM Tweedie on totals with init_score = log(exposure).""" ytr = df_train["Total"].to_numpy(dtype=float) yte = df_test["Total"].to_numpy(dtype=float) Xtr = df_train[feature_cols].to_numpy() Xte = df_test[feature_cols].to_numpy() exposure_tr = df_train["Exposure"].to_numpy(dtype=float) exposure_te = df_test["Exposure"].to_numpy(dtype=float) init_tr = np.log(np.fmax(exposure_tr, EXPOSURE_FLOOR)) init_te = np.log(np.fmax(exposure_te, EXPOSURE_FLOOR)) dtrain = lgb.Dataset(Xtr, label=ytr, init_score=init_tr) dvalid = lgb.Dataset(Xte, label=yte, init_score=init_te, reference=dtrain) params = { "objective": "tweedie", "tweedie_variance_power": p, "boost_from_average": not LGB_DISABLE_BOOST_FROM_AVERAGE, "verbose": -1, "seed": seed, } gbm = lgb.train( params, dtrain, valid_sets=[dvalid], num_boost_round=num_boost_round, ) rhat_tr = np.asarray(gbm.predict(Xtr)) rhat_te = np.asarray(gbm.predict(Xte)) yhat_tr = rhat_tr * exposure_tr yhat_te = rhat_te * exposure_te return gbm, (yhat_tr, yhat_te) def fit_lgbm_tweedie_rates_weights( df_train: pd.DataFrame, df_test: pd.DataFrame, feature_cols: list[str], p: float, num_boost_round: int = 300, seed: int = 13, ) -> tuple[lgb.Booster, tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]: """LightGBM Tweedie on rates with weight = exposure^(2-p).""" rtr = df_train["Rate"].to_numpy(dtype=float) rte = df_test["Rate"].to_numpy(dtype=float) Xtr = df_train[feature_cols].to_numpy() Xte = df_test[feature_cols].to_numpy() wtr = (df_train["Exposure"].to_numpy()) ** (2.0 - p) wte = (df_test["Exposure"].to_numpy()) ** (2.0 - p) dtrain = lgb.Dataset(Xtr, label=rtr, weight=wtr) dvalid = lgb.Dataset(Xte, label=rte, weight=wte, reference=dtrain) params = { "objective": "tweedie", "tweedie_variance_power": p, "boost_from_average": not LGB_DISABLE_BOOST_FROM_AVERAGE, "verbose": -1, "seed": seed, } gbm = lgb.train( params, dtrain, valid_sets=[dvalid], num_boost_round=num_boost_round, ) rhat_tr = np.asarray(gbm.predict(Xtr)) rhat_te = np.asarray(gbm.predict(Xte)) yhat_tr = rhat_tr * df_train["Exposure"].to_numpy() yhat_te = rhat_te * df_test["Exposure"].to_numpy() return gbm, (yhat_tr, yhat_te), (rhat_tr, rhat_te) ``` ::: ## Experiments ::: {#28aef0a4 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} def evaluate_deviance( y_true: np.ndarray, y_hat: np.ndarray, p: float, sample_weight: np.ndarray | None = None, name: str = "", ) -> float: """Calculate the average half Tweedie deviance.""" val = mean_tweedie_deviance( y_true, np.maximum(y_hat, 1e-12), sample_weight=sample_weight, power=p, ) / 2 if name: print(f"{name}: avg half-deviance = {val:.6f}") return val N = 80_000 p = 1.9 phi = 0.8 alpha = 0.1 test_size = 0.25 seed = 42 df = make_insurance_data(n=N, p_index=p, phi=phi, n_features=8, seed=seed) feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("x")] df_train, df_test = train_test_split( df, test_size=test_size, random_state=seed, shuffle=True ) print_table( "Run Configuration", ( ("n_samples", N), ("Tweedie power p", p), ("dispersion phi (generator)", phi), ("alpha (sklearn)", alpha), ( "LightGBM exact-equivalence mode", "boost_from_average=False" if LGB_DISABLE_BOOST_FROM_AVERAGE else "boost_from_average=True", ), ), ) ``` ::: {.cell-output ``` ::: ::: ## scikit-learn: rates + correct weights ::: {#c811b2c2 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} ( sk_model, (sk_yhat_tr, sk_yhat_te), (sk_rhat_tr, sk_rhat_te), (Xtr, Xte, rtr, rte, wtr, wte), ) = fit_sklearn_tweedie_rates(df_train, df_test, feature_cols, p, alpha=alpha) ytr = df_train["Total"].to_numpy() yte = df_test["Total"].to_numpy() dev_tr = evaluate_deviance(ytr, sk_yhat_tr, p) dev_te = evaluate_deviance(yte, sk_yhat_te, p) print_table( "scikit-learn (rates + exposure^(2-p) weights)", ( ("train half-deviance", dev_tr), ("test half-deviance", dev_te), ), ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Equivalence checks ::: {#20f5cb56 .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} def rel_rmse(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> float: """Relative root mean squared error.""" denom = np.maximum(np.abs(a) + np.abs(b), 1e-6) return math.sqrt(np.mean(((a - b) / denom) ** 2)) print_table( "Equivalence Checks (test set)", ( ( "RMSE: LGB offset vs LGB exact weighted rate", root_mean_squared_error(lgb_off_yhat_te, lgb_wt_yhat_te), ), ( "Relative RMSE: LGB offset vs LGB exact weighted rate", rel_rmse(lgb_off_yhat_te, lgb_wt_yhat_te), ), ( "RMSE: sklearn vs LGB offset", root_mean_squared_error(sk_yhat_te, lgb_off_yhat_te), ), ( "Relative RMSE: sklearn vs LGB offset", rel_rmse(sk_yhat_te, lgb_off_yhat_te), ), ( "RMSE: sklearn vs LGB exact weighted rate", root_mean_squared_error(sk_yhat_te, lgb_wt_yhat_te), ), ( "Relative RMSE: sklearn vs LGB exact weighted rate", rel_rmse(sk_yhat_te, lgb_wt_yhat_te), ), ), ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ## Special cases: p=1 (Poisson) and p=2 (Gamma) ::: {#3bcf5181 .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} for p_special in (1.0, 2.0): df_sp = make_insurance_data( n=40_000, p_index=p_special, phi=phi, n_features=6, seed=123 ) df_tr, df_te = train_test_split(df_sp, test_size=0.25, random_state=0) glm_sp, (yhat_tr_sp, yhat_te_sp), _, _ = fit_sklearn_tweedie_rates( df_tr, df_te, [c for c in df_sp.columns if c.startswith("x")], p_special, alpha=alpha, ) dev_sp = evaluate_deviance(df_te["Total"].to_numpy(), yhat_te_sp, p_special) print_table( f"Special Case p = {p_special:.1f}", ( ("test deviance (sklearn)", dev_sp), ("expected rate weight", "exposure" if p_special == 1.0 else "1"), ), ) emit("\nAll done.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
